sources.title: AlphaFold Protein Structure Database
sources.snippet: AlphaFold is an AI system developed by Google DeepMind that predicts a protein's 3D structure from its amino acid sequence. It regularly achieves accuracy competitive with experiment.

sources.title: Artificial intelligence enabled microstructure prediction in Al alloy ...
sources.snippet: Seven artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms have been systematically evaluated, and the eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) was identified as the most robust model for microstructure prediction.
